meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 输入基因名,几秒拿到数据库注释与序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做生物信息研究,经常需要快速查询基因或序列数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene and sequence databases in seconds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do bioinformatics research and need fast database lookups.

howto.what: Claude 会用 gget 命令或 Python 函数查询 20+ 个生物数据库(基因、序列、结构、表达等),并输出 JSON、CSV 或数据表。
howto.when: 当用户要求做基因查询、BLAST/BLAT 比对、蛋白质结构检索等生物信息学快速查寻时触发。

say.text: 查一下人类 ACE2 基因的信息
say.note: 会调用 gget info 返回基因详情。

say.text: 用 gget blast 比对这段蛋白质序列
say.note: 会运行 BLAST 搜索并返回匹配结果。

say.text: 获取小鼠 Pax7 的序列
say.note: 会调用 gget seq 返回 FASTA 序列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use gget CLI/Python functions to query 20+ bio databases (genes, sequences, structures, expression, etc.) and output JSON, CSV, or dataframes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests quick bioinformatics lookups such as gene info, BLAST/BLAT alignment, protein structure retrieval, etc.

say_en.text: Look up info for human gene ACE2.
say_en.note: Calls gget info and returns gene details.

say_en.text: Use gget blast to align this protein sequence.
say_en.note: Runs BLAST and returns top matches.

say_en.text: Get the sequence for mouse Pax7.
say_en.note: Calls gget seq and returns FASTA.
